semantic_label: bake select: forward the two by value extent triples to the port for modes zero and one, or scan the eight byte entry array and keep the strictly smallest answer for mode two
declaration: bool __thiscall editor_bake_select_004c4a30(OpaqueBakeRoot* self, Signed mode, Real low_x, Real low_y, Real low_z, Real high_x, Real high_y, Real high_z, Word* out_first, Word* out_second, Real* out_value, Byte flag)

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x94
abi.return_contract: a byte in AL; 0x004c4d1a writes MOV AL,1 and 0x004c4d1e writes XOR AL,AL, so only the low byte is an answer. 0x004c4cde is not a return site, it is the MOVZX ECX, BYTE PTR [EBP-0x1] that tests the found flag.

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: stage the low triple into a local copy and the high triple into a second local copy, each a twelve byte inline copy
mode zero forwards the port with the receiver self + 0x18 and the three output pointers unchanged
mode one forwards the port with the receiver self + 0x1c
any other mode returns false through the shared epilogue with no dispatch
mode two computes the entry count as the four byte distance between self + 0x4c and self + 0x48 shifted right by three, so an eight byte entry
skip an entry whose first word is zero without a dispatch and use the second word as the receiver
keep the answer when none is held yet or when the returned scalar is strictly less than the held scalar; COMISS with JBE, so a tie keeps the earlier entry
snapshot the scalar first, then the first block, then the second block
publish out_first[0..2] from the winning first block, then out_second[0..2] from the winning second block, then the scalar store, then return true
an empty or fully refused scan returns false and leaves all three outs untouched

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the two opaque receivers at +0x18 and +0x1c and the entry array at +0x48
0x004ccae0 is a dependency-only port, so the extent transform and the answer are unverified in this package
the entry array stride and the block shapes are opaque; only the offsets are pinned
decompilation_defects_corrected: the two extent triples arrive by value, not as caller pointers. At 0x004c4a81 and 0x004c4aad the caller executes SUB ESP,0xc and then three MOVSS, which is a twelve byte inline copy of each triple; the six MOVSS are at 0x004c4a81, 0x004c4aad, 0x004c4b14, 0x004c4bfc and 0x004c4c28, with the high triple copied first and the low triple second. The only pointers the port ever forms are to its own incoming copies of the two triples, at 0x004ccae9 for the high triple and at 0x004ccb56 for the low triple, and those addresses are passed to 0x00449c20 and 0x0050bd90.

the port argument block base is [EBP+0x8], not [EBP+0x4], because [EBP+0x4] still holds the return address at the RET 0x28. The whole caller argument block is [EBP+0x8..0x30], the eleven words the caller itself receives. The port reads the low extent triple at [EBP+0x8] with the LEA EAX,[EBP+0x8] at 0x004ccb56, reads and rewrites the high extent triple in place at [EBP+0x14], [EBP+0x18] and [EBP+0x1c] with the LEA EDX,[EBP+0x14] at 0x004ccb52 and the stores at 0x004ccafb, 0x004ccb01 and 0x004ccb07, takes the flag as a BYTE at [EBP+0x2c] with the MOVZX ECX, BYTE PTR [EBP+0x2c] at 0x004ccb4d, and pushes the three output pointers from [EBP+0x20], [EBP+0x24] and [EBP+0x28] at 0x004ccb3d, 0x004ccb41 and 0x004ccb47. All ten words line up under the [EBP+0x8] base.

the port releases 0x28 bytes: the three call sites push 0x10 for the four stack words plus 0xc and 0xc for the two by value triples, and the port's own last instruction is the RET 0x28 at 0x004ccb69. The caller's own epilogue is the RET 0x2c at 0x004c4d23, which is the eleven stack words it received. The body is 206 instructions.

the decompilation places the mode two output slots four bytes higher than the assembly: the assembly takes the address at frame 0x1c for the first block, 0x30 for the second and 0x20 for the scalar, and snapshots from 0x1c into 0x10 at 0x004c4cb4, from 0x30 into 0x3c at 0x004c4cc6 and from 0x20 into 0x24 at 0x004c4cac and 0x004c4ca7; the decompilation names them 0x20, 0x34 and 0x24

the decompilation reports the port as taking no arguments and so loses the whole six word argument order, and it types the mode arguments three to eight as words, which hides that the assembly moves them as scalars

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
